decision: Retain the unchanged validated recipe. The bounded sensitivity is documented; no source, feature, prediction, blend weight or submission was modified.
derivation: Rounding each prediction to nearest integer changes the difference by at most one second per affected row; add sqrt(affected_rows / all_rows) to the original reverse-triangle bound.
limitation: This measures prediction sensitivity, not the effect of retraining on pressure-filtered data. It uses no hidden labels.
